EmailTemplate.name: IDV - Supplementary/Prepaid Card Notification
EmailTemplate.subject: Support Card Activation Request
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
KYC Documents Requested
Dear Valued Customer,
Greetings form ila, we trust that you are doing great.
We hope this message finds you well. We would like to remind you that you can easily activate your {!Case.Sub_Type__c} through the ila app. To ensure a smooth process, please follow these steps carefully:
Open the ila app and navigate to the cards section. Click on {!Case.Sub_Type__c}. Navigate to your card and click activate button. Ensure you have a valid CPR (Civil Personal Registration) ID and are ready to take a selfie.
Our Support team will be happy to serve you 7 days a week, 24 hours a day on +973 17123456, or you can send us an email to support@ilabank.com
Have a great day!
Bank ABC Tower, Head Office, P.O Box: 5698, Manama, Kingdom of Bahrain
If you have received this message in error, please notify our contact center of the error and delete the message.
Licensed as a Conventional Retail Bank – Branch by the Central Bank of Bahrain
